reading: The most revealing aspect of the recent summit in Washington may be found in what the two leaders chose not to discuss, and what remains unknown.
However, the talks produced no joint statements and few significant advancements.
Instead, both governments issued separate accounts of the meeting, perhaps indicating that despite initial gestures, Washington and Beijing maintain a degree of caution towards each other.
Beijing announced an agreement with Washington to initiate a new artificial intelligence discussion forum, with further consultations scheduled for late November.
This move suggests both nations recognize the necessity of establishing certain safeguards around AI technology, which is increasingly integral to sectors from commerce to military planning.
They also committed to creating a communication channel for AI-related incidents, intending to prevent misunderstandings or unforeseen events from escalating into a broader conflict.
Chinese state media further confirmed that a temporary cessation of new tariffs has been extended until January 10.
Beijing, however, had sought a more substantial extension to the pause in trade disputes, rendering the two-month reprieve a limited concession rather than a significant achievement.
China successfully secured reduced import duties on $30bn (£23bn) of goods entering the US, with reciprocal reductions anticipated from Beijing.
Strikingly, crucial subjects were entirely omitted from public statements.
There was no mention of boosting China's rare earth mineral exports to the US, nor any sign that restrictions on advanced US semiconductors would be relaxed.
The White House factsheet omitted any reference to Taiwan, yet the issue clearly held significant importance for Xi Jinping.
According to Beijing's reports of the discussions, Xi urged Donald Trump to formally oppose Taiwan independence and manage the situation with prudence.
This summit generated extensive discussions, yet yielded minimal shifts in policy for the time being.
The most contentious issues, ranging from advanced technology to Taiwan, persist without full resolution.

While both leaders affirm their commitment to stable relations, ongoing US-China communication appears significantly more straightforward than demanding either superpower to make substantial compromises.

vocabulary.definition: Providing insights or information that was previously hidden or unknown.
Progress or developments in a particular field, often significant.
Suggesting or showing something, often indirectly.
To continue to possess or keep in existence a state or condition.
To cause a process or action to begin; to start.
Essential or fundamental to the completeness of something; forming a necessary part.
Increasing rapidly in intensity or seriousness; worsening.
The formal or complete stopping of an activity; an end.
A temporary escape from an undesirable situation or event; a postponement.
Given, felt, or done in return by each of two people or groups; mutual.
Left out or excluded, either intentionally or by oversight.
The quality of acting with careful good judgment, especially concerning practical matters.
Causing or likely to cause disagreement or argument; controversial.
To state or assert positively; to declare something to be true.
Considerable in extent, amount, or importance; significant.

entries.ja: 以前は隠されていた、あるいは知られていなかった洞察や情報を提供する。
entries.ko: 이전에 숨겨져 있었거나 알려지지 않았던 통찰력이나 정보를 제공하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 提供以前隐藏或未知的信息或见解。
entries.es: Que proporciona información o perspectivas que antes estaban ocultas o eran desconocidas.
entries.pt-BR: Que fornece informações ou percepções que antes estavam ocultas ou eram desconhecidas.

entries.ja: 特定の分野における進歩や発展、しばしば重要なもの。
entries.ko: 특정 분야에서, 종종 중요한 진전이나 발전.
entries.zh-Hans: 特定领域内的进步或发展，通常是重大的。
entries.es: Progresos o desarrollos en un campo particular, a menudo significativos.
entries.pt-BR: Progressos ou desenvolvimentos em uma área específica, muitas vezes significativos.

entries.ja: 何かを示唆したり、見せたりすること（しばしば間接的に）。
entries.ko: 어떤 것을 암시하거나 보여주는 것, 종종 간접적으로.
entries.zh-Hans: 暗示或显示某事，通常是间接地。
entries.es: Sugerir o mostrar algo, a menudo de forma indirecta.
entries.pt-BR: Sugerir ou mostrar algo, muitas vezes indiretamente.

entries.ja: ある状態や条件を引き続き所有し、存在させ続けること。
entries.ko: 어떤 상태나 조건을 계속해서 소유하거나 존재하도록 유지하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 继续拥有或保持某种状态或条件。
entries.es: Continuar poseyendo o manteniendo un estado o condición.
entries.pt-BR: Continuar a possuir ou a manter um estado ou condição.

entries.ja: 過程や行動を開始させること。始めること。
entries.ko: 과정이나 행동이 시작되도록 하는 것; 시작하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 导致某个过程或行动开始；启动。
entries.es: Hacer que un proceso o una acción comience; iniciar.
entries.pt-BR: Fazer com que um processo ou uma ação comece; iniciar.

entries.ja: 何かの完全性にとって不可欠であるか基本的なもので、必要な部分を形成すること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것의 완전성에 필수적이거나 근본적인 것으로, 필요한 부분을 이루는.
entries.zh-Hans: 对某事物的完整性至关重要或根本的；构成必要部分。
entries.es: Esencial o fundamental para la completitud de algo; que forma una parte necesaria.
entries.pt-BR: Essencial ou fundamental para a completude de algo; que forma uma parte necessária.

entries.ja: 強度や深刻さにおいて急速に増大すること。悪化すること。
entries.zh-Hans: 在强度或严重性上迅速增加；恶化。
entries.es: Aumentar rápidamente en intensidad o gravedad; empeorar.
entries.pt-BR: Aumentar rapidamente em intensidade ou seriedade; piorar.

entries.ja: 活動の正式または完全な停止。終わり。
entries.ko: 어떤 활동의 공식적이거나 완전한 중단; 끝.
entries.zh-Hans: 一项活动的正式或完全停止；结束。
entries.es: La interrupción formal o completa de una actividad; un fin.
entries.pt-BR: A interrupção formal ou completa de uma atividade; um fim.

entries.ja: 望ましくない状況や出来事からの短期的な脱出。延期。
entries.ko: 원치 않는 상황이나 사건으로부터의 일시적인 탈출; 유예.
entries.zh-Hans: 暂时摆脱不愉快的情况或事件；延期。
entries.es: Un escape temporal de una situación o evento indeseable; un aplazamiento.
entries.pt-BR: Um escape temporário de uma situação ou evento indesejável; um adiamento.

entries.ja: 二人または二つのグループによって、お互いに返礼として与えられたり、感じられたり、行われたりする。相互の。
entries.ko: 두 사람이나 그룹이 서로에게 보답으로 주거나 느끼거나 행하는; 상호적인.
entries.zh-Hans: 由两个人或两个团体互惠地给予、感受或执行；相互的。
entries.es: Dado, sentido o hecho a cambio por cada una de dos personas o grupos; mutuo.
entries.pt-BR: Dado, sentido ou feito em troca por cada uma de duas pessoas ou grupos; mútuo.

entries.ja: 意図的に、または見落としによって、取り残されるか除外されること。
entries.zh-Hans: 有意或因疏忽而遗漏或排除的。
entries.es: Dejar fuera o excluir, ya sea intencionalmente o por descuido.
entries.pt-BR: Deixado de fora ou excluído, seja intencionalmente ou por descuido.

entries.ja: 特に実際的な事柄に関して、慎重かつ的確な判断をもって行動する資質。
entries.ko: 특히 실용적인 문제에 관하여 신중하고 현명한 판단으로 행동하는 특성.
entries.zh-Hans: 以谨慎而周全的判断行事的品质，特别是在实际事务上。
entries.es: La cualidad de actuar con buen juicio y cautela, especialmente en asuntos prácticos.
entries.pt-BR: A qualidade de agir com bom julgamento e cautela, especialmente em assuntos práticos.

entries.ja: 不和や議論を引き起こす、または引き起こしそうな。物議を醸す。
entries.ko: 의견 불일치나 논쟁을 일으키거나 일으킬 가능성이 있는; 논란의 여지가 있는.
entries.zh-Hans: 引起或可能引起分歧或争论的；有争议的。
entries.es: Que causa o es probable que cause desacuerdo o discusión; controvertido.
entries.pt-BR: Que causa ou é provável que cause desacordo ou discussão; controverso.

entries.ja: 肯定的に述べる、または断言する。何かが真実であると宣言する。
entries.ko: 긍정적으로 진술하거나 단언하는 것; 어떤 것이 사실이라고 선언하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 肯定地陈述或主张；宣布某事为真。
entries.es: Declarar o afirmar positivamente; declarar que algo es cierto.
entries.pt-BR: Declarar ou afirmar positivamente; declarar que algo es verdadero.

entries.ja: 程度、量、または重要性においてかなりの。重要な。
entries.ko: 범위, 양 또는 중요성 면에서 상당한; 중요한.
entries.zh-Hans: 在范围、数量或重要性上可观的；重大的。
entries.es: Considerable en extensión, cantidad o importancia; significativo.
entries.pt-BR: Considerável em extensão, quantidade ou importância; significativo.
